q: What is the energy use and CO2 of the Giridih secondary steel cluster in Jharkhand?
title: Giridih secondary steel: energy and CO2
short: TERI's May 2024 profile puts Giridih's steel units at 1.49 million t of coal and 1,095 million kWh a year, about 0.88 million toe, and 3.93 million t CO2. Sponge iron is half of it: 1.97 million t CO2 from 0.75 million t of DRI.
audience: Sponge iron, pig iron, steel melting, ferro alloy, re-rolling and wire units around Tundi Road, Giridih

ul: About 30 steel units, mostly on Tundi Road. TERI's production table: DRI 7,50,000 t, pig iron 6,45,000 t, steel melting 6,00,000 t, ferro alloys 37,400 t, re-rolling, wire and others 5,86,800 t.
Known for Fe 550 and Fe 600 TMT bars; also billets, wire rod, binding and barbed wire, nails.
Most units take DVC power for its reliability and lower tariff.
DRI: 1.05 million t of coal and 90 million kWh, 1.97 million t CO2.
Pig iron: 0.39 million t of coal and coke, 1.17 million t CO2.
Steel melting: 720 million kWh, 0.51 million t CO2.
Ferro alloys: 180 million kWh, 0.21 million t CO2.

sections.h: Giridih kilns burn more coal per tonne
p: 1.05 million t of coal for 0.75 million t of DRI is 1.4 t a tonne. TERI's Ballari study puts sponge iron at 1.0 to 1.2 t. Some of the gap is coal quality, so compare heat per tonne using your coal's GCV, but a kiln at 1.4 t has room to save.

ul: Waste heat power: a 2 x 100 tpd DRI plant could generate about 4 MW.
Better kiln lining: about 5 kg of coal saved per tonne.
Recuperators on reheating furnaces: up to 25% less fuel.
Continuous casting with direct rolling in place of reheating, and IE3 or IE4 motors: about 10% of motor power.

example.title: CO2 per tonne by unit type (from the profile)
lines: DRI: 1.97 million t CO2 / 0.75 million t = 2.6 t CO2 per tonne
Pig iron: 1.17 / 0.645 = 1.8 t CO2 per tonne
Steel melting: 0.51 / 0.60 = 0.85 t CO2 per tonne (1,200 kWh a tonne)
Ferro alloys: 0.21 / 0.0374 = 5.6 t CO2 per tonne
Cluster: 3.93 / 2.62 = 1.5 t CO2 per tonne of all products
example.note: From TERI's May 2024 Giridih profile. The cluster average adds stages that feed each other, so use your own unit type.

senseible: Senseible reads coal invoices and DVC bills into monthly records you can divide by tonnes; coke needs your supplier's factor. The CBAM pages show what a DRI or billet figure means for an EU buyer.
